prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though several strong winners (such as in sign_in redesign, choose_path redesign, adoption new_flow, adoption incentive, choose_path copy, finish redesign, and adoption redesign) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 9 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 6 showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 9 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the remaining 7 showed no clear effect.
Choose_path redesign changes were helpful in some cases, winning 2 of 7 tests (rounds 10 and 15), while others showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Finish new_screen changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Evidence remains thin or outcomes are mixed for single-test categories and categories with conflicting results (such as adoption redesign, finish redesign, sign_in redesign, home notification, adoption incentive, and choose_path layout).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Spotlight Selection Redesign: Redesigns the character selection screen into a spotlight layout that focuses visually on individual pet models and their traits. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.7% with a median time of 89s; a spotlight visual focus simplifies character evaluation.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Restoration Safety Hint: Adds an explanatory hint below sign-in options reminding users to log in with their primary account to preserve pet data. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating account confusion during login.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Render Status Wait Info: Displays estimated render initialization time and live progress updates on the waiting screen. (why: The home wait step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), causing user dropped off due to lack of feedback.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Style Selector Flow: Inserts a style selection screen prior to photo upload so users can pick an art direction for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results; pre-selecting a render style improves generation accuracy.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Screen Desktop Guide Redesign: Redesigns the final home intro welcome screen into a split layout highlighting essential desktop pet controls. (why: Finish completion drops to 72.5% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets on desktop after setup.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a stage layout highlighting option choices side-by-side with mascot visual cues. (why: Choose path mean duration reaches 514s despite high initial pass rate; stage framing helps users decide faster.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Engine Tray Notification Switch: Enables readiness desktop notification alerts so users are notified when pet loading completes. (why: Initialization mean wait is over 38 minutes (2336s), causing users to switch to other desktop apps during setup.)
7: [finish, copy] Finish Desktop Control Directives Copy: Updates the home intro body text with explicit instructions on desktop right-clicking and system tray controls. (why: Support receives recurring tickets from post-onboarding users confused about how to interact with or hide their pet on screen.)
8: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Layout Account Protection Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout pairing authentication buttons with explicit cloud save safety details. (why: 8 support emails cited lost pets due to duplicate account sign-ins; prominent layout space for data protection guidance prevents accidental account resets.)
